name: Learn a simple salsa routine
blurb: The basic step, a right turn, a cross-body lead and a couple of combinations — enough to dance a whole song socially and enjoy it.
steps: Learn to hear the beat and count 1-2-3, pause, 5-6-7, pause. Timing is what separates dancing salsa from moving to salsa.
Learn the basic step on the spot, on1, until your feet do it without thought.
Learn the side basic and the back basic so you can move rather than staying planted.
Learn the right turn for both roles, keeping it on time.
Learn the cross-body lead — the fundamental figure that most combinations are built from.
Chain four moves into a routine, then go to a social night and dance it with strangers.
tips: Dancing off-beat is the one thing experienced dancers notice immediately. Fix the timing before adding moves.
Lead gently. Forceful leading is uncomfortable and unnecessary.
Social dancing with many partners improves you far faster than practising a routine alone.
proof: You dance a full song socially with a stranger, on time, using at least four different figures.
